# Language

How we write every word, for everyone PLUS reaches.

**Kind:** Foundation

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/styles/ContentLanguage.mdx`

## Words

Use the word a tutor would say out loud.

### Pick everyday words

Verbs over nouns. Short words over long ones.

Do: A verb the reader can act on.
Don't: Correct, but “availability” is an abstract noun to decode.

### Spell out team terms

New tutors don’t know our shorthand yet. Write the full name.

Do: Clear on day one.
Don't: Fine for a lead tutor. A new tutor has to ask.

| Say | Not |
| --- | --- |
| session | meeting, class |
| call off | cancel |
| fill-in | sub |
| lead tutor | TA, captain |
| reflection | survey |
| student | kid, tutee |

## People

PLUS reaches students, families and schools who never open the app. Write so every one of them is included.

### Describe the work

Say what a student is learning. Leave out labels about who they are.

Do: Specific, and it points forward.
Don't: True, but it labels Leo and doesn’t say which skill.

### Don’t assume a household

Families look different. So do devices and quiet rooms.

Do: Works for every family.
Don't: Close, but leaves out a grandparent or older sibling.

### Show the least you need

On shared screens, first name and last initial. No names in research exports.

Do: Enough to find her.
Don't: Fine in a private record. Too much on a projected screen.

## Sentences

### Say who acted

Name the person behind a change. Passive voice hides them.

Do: The tutor knows who to thank or ask.
Don't: Fine in a tight flag. In a notice, it hides who decided.

### Write as “we” and “you”

PLUS is “we”. The reader is “you”. Use contractions.

Do: A promise from someone.
Don't: Accurate, but no one is making the promise.

## Mechanics

One way to write each thing, so every screen reads the same.

| Topic | Rule | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Capitalization | Sentence case everywhere | Open session notes |
| Punctuation | No period in titles, buttons or labels. No exclamation marks in errors. | Reflection submitted |
| Numbers | Digits in the UI. Spell out one to nine in a sentence. | 3 sessions left |
| Dates | Shortest clear format. Add the year only in records. | Wed, Nov 13 |
| Times | 12-hour, with the time zone | 3:30 PM ET |
| Ranges | En dash, no spaces | 3:30–4:15 PM ET |
| Recent | Relative under a week, then the date | 10 min ago · Yesterday · Nov 4 |
| School calendar | Terms, not quarters | Fall term |

### Always add the time zone

Tutors and schools sit in different zones.

Do: Means the same thing everywhere.
Don't: Reads fine, until a tutor in another zone joins an hour late.
